findings.text: the module restates the live-name, live-child and no-producer predicates that imas_codex/standard_names/source_invariant.py:11-24 exports for sibling modules to compose, and NO_PRODUCER_TEST (no producer edge at all, source_reads.py:27) differs from the owner's rule (no producer whose status is not stale), so `imas-codex sn sourceless` and the export gate's find_sourceless_live_names can report different populations: the change adds a second definition of the repository's sourceless population under a goal that exists to leave one.

the review pipeline's _load_catalog still returns sn.source_paths and its ids-prefix filter consumes it, so a reader in a file this change edited still answers from the copy for the 586 live names whose copy disagrees with their producer edges.

_without_extraction_records drops every module-level assignment whose target ends in _EXTRACTION_RECORD, so a live reader parked in a constant named that way is exempt from a guard whose docstring claims to refuse every reader that spells the copied list.
